kitDescription: Label is an Iron AR Defender whose burst-stage-I kit is built around a self-shield called Delusion: she creates a shield worth 30.15% of her own max HP at battle start, and while that shield is up she gains +93.39% ATK and +70.4% burst-gauge fill speed on herself. Her burst raises her own max HP by 20.26% for 10 seconds and makes her shield invulnerable for that same window (Shared Delusion), during which every ally except herself gains bonus ATK equal to 80.36% of Label's ATK. If the shield ever breaks she becomes briefly untargetable and stunned, and she can re-create the shield by attacking or bursting — but none of that happens when nothing damages her. She also carries Electric-code damage-taken reduction for herself and, for the first 5 seconds, her allies. Against the partless test boss with no incoming damage, her shield never breaks, so her practical contribution is her own buffed AR fire plus the burst-window ally ATK grant.

verdictRationale: No gotchas: all 11 kit lines are FAITHFUL (5) or DOCUMENTED_GAP (6), every gap recorded verbatim with its reason, and both ⚑ flags carry estimate+recipe+tier (cadence tuple: mandatory datamine-unreliable with a focus-video recipe; Delusion-uptime: defensive out-of-domain gap). The blind re-derivations converged on substance: S6's override matches the driver on every load-bearing decision (sole delta is cosmetic block-grouping of the two self passives), and the S5 blind test runs 16/0-fail/3-skip against the shipped override after mechanical-only adaptation — its 5 pre-adaptation REDs all traced to the S2b-predicted fixture hazard (controlComp puts liter alongside Label at B1 so Label never casts) and to crown's casterAtkPct contaminating the blind ally-buff filter, proven non-faithfulness by green-after-isolation. Discrimination is real across the board: liveness (noAtk collapses her total), scoping (allies-widening lifts ada), basis (atkPct records the raw 80.36 and over-buffs high-ATK ada), timing (burstCast frames ≠ FB-entry frames), and present-but-inert (totals byte-equal on Max-HP strip). The two genuine judgment calls — collapsing the Delusion gate to a passive under the v1 no-incoming-damage premise, and inferring the Shared Delusion window as the burst's 10 seconds despite skill2's bare 'continuously' — were made independently by all three agents and are corroborated by the prose plus the mechanics SSOT. Same-model residual for the owner to spot-check: the 10s Shared Delusion window is an inference (prose never prints a duration for the ally line) that every same-model agent found natural, and the passive gate-collapse assumes the shield never breaks — both are flagged in the override's caveats, so a one-minute owner read of those two caveats is the remaining human check.
